notes.title: Multiplayer Lobby and fix UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]MULTIPLAYER [/b]

- New Lobby System :

Before each game the players are sent to a lobby, to be able to make the game settings, change the map, choose the AI, etc. In addition to all this, now at the end of each game players are sent back to the lobby.

- Doors Fix : 

Despite the fix from the last update, the doors were still subject to desync, we found the problem and fixed it. 

- Server List : 

Server list now refresh automatically.

[b]UI[/b]

- New Stamina UI : 

Many players have asked us to add a UI to know their amount of stamina, here it is.

[b]GAMEMODE[/b]

- Jerrycan Spawn Issue :

 The inaccessible jerrycan spawn in the hangar map was modified.

notes.title: Rework Update
notes.notes:
- Rework of the Sprinting system ( Now Sprinting is smooth even when the player's ping is high )

- Rework of the audio screamer system : ( the old system triggered the audio screamers by drawing a line corresponding to the player's view, now the entire player's screen is taken into account )

notes.title: Co-op vs AI Update
notes.notes:
[b]New Multiplayer Mode :[/b]

 - Play with you're friends in co-op vs the killer AI ! ( 4 Difficulties : Easy, Medium, Hard, Impossible ).

- New AI for the Killer ( Singleplayer and Multiplayer ), Unpredictable, mischievous and terrifying !

notes.title: SinglePlayer Fix Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue where killer get stuck on door.
- Some minor AI Fix
- New : AI will now scream when spawning close to you.
- New Main Menu Logo

notes.title: Post Release Update
notes.notes:
- New Singleplayer Mode ( Only one difficulty for the moment )

Three new modes will arrive however (Easy, hard, impossible), with in addition the improvement of the IA to make it more intelligent and deceitful.

- Killer Buff : +33 % move speed 

Some people find that the killer is too slow, and we agree with them so here is a buff that will make the killer more dangerous during the game.

- Doors now opens and closes two time faster

The doors prevent the killer from progressing correctly, thanks to this, the killer should no longer be too much bothered by it. We are still waiting for feedback to find out if we should go further in this process.
